autoManufacture.title: Auto-manufacture
autoManufacture.description: When a store order is paid, Hoard can make what it sells at once, from its {{recipe}}, by a production run that completes as it opens.

choices.out_of_stock: Make only what is out of stock

base.description: When a run uses this {{base}}, Hoard can make it first, from its {{recipe}}, by a run that completes as it opens. A {{base}} that cures can't be made this way.

choices.always: Always make what a run uses
choices.out_of_stock: Make only what a run is short of
